case_title: State through C.B.I. v. Mahender Singh Dahiya
neutral_facts: The accused, an orthopedic surgeon, married the deceased, his daughter, and they went on a honeymoon trip. During the trip, the deceased disappeared, and her body parts were found in various locations. The prosecution alleged that the accused strangled his wife to death and then dismembered and disposed of her body. The trial court convicted the accused under Section 302 and 201 of the IPC, but the High Court acquitted him, finding the prosecution failed to connect him with the murder. The accused claimed the deceased left him voluntarily, and there was no reliable evidence linking him to the crime.
